sentences.text: Cherry has just shown Bonnie and Julian a draft of her PowerPoint slides for the presentation, Bonnie and Julian are now giving her some feedback.
Listen to the conversation and make notes in the note sheet below.
One has been provided as an example, You now have 30 seconds hands to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Okay, so what do you think?
Well, I think it’s brilliant overall.
You've done a really good job.
But. I'm sensing a butt here.
but Well, I think it might be a bit light on content.
Okay, so I was thinking that as well.
We could maybe add a couple more slides.
What do you think is missing or it could be expanded on?
Yeah, I was wondering if we needed more on the downsides, you know, negatives about organizing World Expos.
So, I would add a slide on that.
Maybe include some key points on the slide.
The first one would be something about the millions of dollars wasted on World Expos, and the fact that the money could be better spent.
Yeah, I'd include something like that, I mean, the host country has to be prepared to spend millions on creating a World Expo.
One of the other downsides we could include is the disruption to life in the host city.
You know, World Expos have to be built and existing roads to the Expo site have to be improved or new roads have to be constructed.

So, it can can cause a lot of disruption for people living in the host city Another disadvantage we could include is that very often people complain that the Expo buildings are not used again after the end of the
Expo. Really? Yeah, occasionally the buildings are re-used, but more often than not they are just taken down
OK, well I think I can do a slide on that.
Is there anything else to include?
Another slide maybe?
Well, I think we could include one on the reasons why a city would want to host a World Expo.
friendship among different countries.
Many different countries work together on each Expo, so it's a wonderful way to promote international friendship.
The second reason for holding World Expos is so that different countries that take part in World Expos can build up their national image.
You know, countries can show how beautiful their countries are and how friendly their people are.
Plus, holding exposed can attract business and tourism, Right, OK.
Got it. I'll include all these points in two extra slides.
I'll get the draft ready to give to Jasmine, Thanks guys, Any comments on the presentation, I mean the way it looks and Well, I think generally it’s a bit wordy.
You know too many words on each slide.
So, could we take out some of the writing?
OK, less writing, right.
Hang on, let me get my laptop to write these comments down so I don’t forget.
OK. That would help definitely.
Plus I was thinking we could put in more visuals, you know, more pictures, I think it will make the presentation look much more interesting.
What do you think?
Sure, I can add more visuals.
shows. Yeah, another point I thought of was to change the background color to light blue.
White looks a bit boring, so why not have a light blue background instead of white, so it looks more colorful.
Yeah, I had a similar comment I'd noted down.
What do you think, Sherry?
Yep, fine. I was actually going to do that anyway in the next draft.
Okay, so change the background color to light blue.
What else? Another point is maybe put all the main headings in red instead of having all the writing in black just to make it look more interesting.
Yeah, good idea.
So put headings in red Another point is the size of the writing.
I think it’s a bit small can we make it bigger so it’s easier for the audience to read?
Hmm. so make the writing bigger.
bigger How about changing the font too?
I always think Times New Roman looks so old fashioned.
Can we make it more, you know, up -to -date looking?
Okay, change the font to make it look more modern.
then. Actually, in relation to that I was wondering whether we should use numbers or bullet points.
In the end, I use numbers, but do you think bullet points would look better?
Yeah I do less formal and more visual Okay, so change numbers to bullet points.
Right, OK. Got it.
I'll get the drafts ready to give to Jasmine then.
Thanks guys
